rationale: The agent encountered an error when trying to delete `helper_utils.py` due to a permission error. It recovered well by first attempting to delete the file via a Python script, recognizing the failure (permission denied), and then overwriting the file with a deprecation notice. While it took a few attempts and an unnecessary intermediate step (creating `temp_cleanup.py`), it ultimately addressed the problem as best it could given the constraints and clearly communicated the situation to the user. It showed good engagement with the error and didn't simply give up.
